en.t: The place where the horses were kept was close by.

units.source_text: 望见那边有一所形似谷仓的小屋，从其中取草秣来喂马，宰相看了亦觉稀罕。

en.t: They could see over there a small hut shaped like a granary, and when fodder was taken from it to feed the horses, the captain found the sight unusual too.

units.source_text: 看到喂马，想起了催马乐《飞鸟井》，两人便齐声吟唱起来。

en.t: Seeing the horses being fed reminded them of the saibara song Asukai, and the two began chanting it together in unison.

units.source_text: 继而共谈别后年月中种种情状，时而悲泣，时而欢笑。

en.t: Then they spoke together of all that had happened in the years since they parted, at times weeping in sorrow and at times laughing with joy.

units.source_text: 谈到小公子夕雾无知无识嬉笑玩耍之状，以及左大臣日夜替外孙操心等事，源氏公子悲伤不堪。

en.t: When they spoke of the little young lord Yugiri laughing and playing in innocent ignorance, and of the Minister of the Left worrying day and night over his grandson, Lord Genji was overcome with grief.
All these things are difficult to recount in full.
What has been written above does not convey even one part in ten thousand.
